claimsCompared.claim: A stock represents company ownership; dividends and price gains are not guaranteed.
claimsCompared.assessment: Supported by StocksFAQs ownership definition and explicit no-guarantee/loss discussion. Voting rights and payment priority depend on stock class; this receipt does not certify every stock-rights claim.

claimsCompared.claim: ETF designation alone establishes neither diversification nor a low-risk rating.
claimsCompared.assessment: Supported by the SEC single-stockETF counterexample: single-stock focus does not diversify, leveraged exposure can amplify volatility/risk. This short glossary entry does not establish every fund expense, holdings, or mandate claim.

claimsCompared.claim: Invented equal-weighted two-name fund loses10% when one falls20% and other is unchanged, and20% when both fall20%.
claimsCompared.assessment: Independent no-cost arithmetic:0.5*(-0.2)+0.5*0=-0.1;0.5*(-0.2)+0.5*(-0.2)=-0.2. Not a forecast or source endorsement of a real fund.

claimsCompared.claim: Two tickers can overlap:50direct companyA plus50fund with20%A yields60A exposure.
claimsCompared.assessment: Independent worksheet arithmetic50+50*.2=60 of100. Product holdings require separate current documents; short SEC glossary is not verification of an actual fund holding.

limitations: Four bounded definition/arithmetic comparisons only. Full individual lesson source/originality, current real fund holdings, schedules, conditional subtopics and full accessibility remain incomplete. No account/order/quiz/progress or production mutation.
